description: The best price for a token swap on one network, or a transfer to another network (bridge), and the transaction that makes it, through our contract. Returns toAmount, toAmountMin (enforced on-chain), the fees, approvalAddress (approve it for exactly fromAmount first unless fromToken is the coin) and transactionRequest for the user to sign. Needs an API key.

fromAddress.description: The wallet that pays and signs

fromAmount.description: Amount sold, an integer string in the token's smallest unit

fromChainId.description: Network chain id, e.g. 8453 for Base (see get_networks)

integratorBps.description: Your own fee in basis points, up to your key's limit

slippageBps.description: Max price move in basis points, 1 to 5000 (default 50)

toAddress.description: Where the tokens go; defaults to fromAddress

toChainId.description: Where the recipient receives: fromChainId for a swap (the default), or another of the router's networks to bridge there (toToken an asset the bridge carries, like USDC or ETH; any fromToken is swapped first when needed)

name: get_quote
title: Get a quote
